english.title: Possess shotgun while committing Schedule 1 offence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) at the time of committing an offence specified in Schedule 1 to the Firearms Act 1968, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFENCE..), had in your possession a shotgun
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17(2) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings: H1750, H1751, H2201, H2203, H2204 and H2231.(ii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968). (iii) Paragraph 6 of Part II of Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968 apply.
(iv) This offence is a specified violent offence under section 306 of the Sentencing Act 2020, see Part 1 of Schedule 18 to that Act; this is, for example, relevant for certain extended sentences of detention or imprisonment.
(v) Where an offender has already been convicted for this offence and commits a further specified offence, an extended sentence may be available, see sections 267 and 280 of, and Schedule 14 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.
(vi) This offence is also an index offence and previous offence under section 273 of the Sentencing Act 2020 when a court decides on imposing custody for life for a second listed offence under section 272 or a life sentence as provided for in section 283, see Schedule 15 to that Act.
(vii) This offence is also a Schedule 19 offence under section 307 of, and Schedule 19 to, the Sentencing Act 2020 carrying a maximum of imprisonment for life, see sections 258, 274 and 285 of that Act for required sentences of detention/custody for life.
(viii) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
